name: Saimin Gakuen
source:
My name is Nobuo.
I have something of an ability.

What kind of ability, you ask?
The ability to change minds.

--------------------------------------------------
Nobuo has transferred to school with lots of cute girls
--------------------------------------------------

Today's day one at my new "gakuen".
Wonder what sort of sights I'll see.
Heh heh heh.

Word is that the school is full of kawaii girls.
I'm looking forward to them.
